bar.savedDropped: Raid plan saved. {count} assignment(s) to players no longer in the setup were removed.

conflict.text: Someone changed the raid plan in the meantime. Your changes are still here, but you can only save after reloading.

noInstance.title: No instance is set for this event.
noInstance.text: The raid plan makes one board for every boss of the chosen instance. Pick the instance under "Manage event" → Edit.

setupHint.none: There is no setup yet. Without a setup there are no players to place.
setupHint.notApproved: The setup is not approved yet. You can plan already, but the read view only names players once the setup is approved.

board.noMapText: Upload a boss room map, it will sit behind the players.
board.mapHelp: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 3 MB. A boss without a map of its own uses its instance's map.
board.mapTooBig: The image is larger than 3 MB.
board.mapRemoveText: The map is deleted. Plans stay, they show the grid instead.
board.hint: Drag elements from the palette and players from the list onto the board or onto a slot. Right click (touch: long press) opens the menu, a double click the properties, Delete removes, Ctrl+Z undoes.
board.hintTemplate: Drag elements from the palette onto the board, or click them. Right click (touch: long press) opens the menu, a double click the properties, Delete removes, Ctrl+Z undoes.
board.mapResetText: This map is deleted, the board shows the template's map or the default map again.

tray.title: Not placed
tray.empty: Every player is on the board.

targets.title: Tasks
targets.empty: No rows yet. Add one or pick a tactic.
targets.rowsFull: More than {max} rows are not possible.

profile.label: Tactic
profile.empty: There is no tactic for this boss yet. Create rows and save them as a tactic.
profile.applyText: This boss's rows and note are replaced by those of the tactic. Players assigned to a row keep it when the title stays the same.
profile.saveHint: The rows (titles only) and the note are saved, no players.
profile.name: Name
profile.categoryPlaceholder: Pick a category or type a new one
profile.needRows: Add at least one row first.
profile.deleteText: Rows already applied in plans stay, only the template goes away.
profile.manageHint: Changing a tactic does not change rows that were already applied.

share.title: Publish the raid plan
share.text: Once published, anyone with the link can read the plan without logging in. Whoever logs in sees their own token highlighted.
share.unpublished: The plan was withdrawn, the link no longer answers.
share.unsavedHint: There are unsaved changes. What is saved is what gets published.
share.noSetup: The setup is not approved yet, so the read view has no players.

public.notFound: This raid plan does not exist (any more).
public.empty: Nothing is planned for this event yet.
public.you: You are in the plan for this boss.
public.youNot: You are not in the plan for this boss.
public.loginHint: Log in and your spot is highlighted.

slot.openTip: Slots without a player: nobody in the setup had a fitting role, or you left them open.
slot.groupHint: A group marker names the players of the setup group with this number.

zone.label: Label
zone.patternHint: The type is also shown as a symbol and a label inside the zone, not by colour alone.

add.title: Add object
add.hint: It appears in the middle, drag it away.
add.label: Add label

selection.hint: Arrow keys move, Delete removes, Enter opens the details.

template.hint: Copies the template into this plan. Later changes to the template do not reach it.
template.noneYet: There is no template yet. Make one under Raid events → Raid plan templates.
template.applyText: The template's bosses replace the boards in this plan, unsaved changes to them are lost. Bosses the template does not have stay.
template.applied: Template "{name}" applied. Open slots are marked on the board.
template.hintEmpty: Tip: "Pick a template" starts you from a template.

palette.title: Elements
palette.hint: Drag onto the board or click.

insp.none: Nothing selected. Click an object on the board or in the layer list, or drag something from the elements onto the board.
